I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: Quarrendon Freight Lines is at **185 seats now and goes to 230 on 2027-01-01**. I told her not to use 261, the number Ilse posted on Oct 14, which I had acknowledged without checking.

- **No signed document says 261.**
- **185:** The 2026 renewal order form (signed 2026-03-20, effective 2026-04-01, renews 2027-03-31) didn't change the seat count. That leaves the 185 from Amendment No. 1, which matches what Dana herself corrected in #north-team in Aug 2025.
- **230:** Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, raises the count to 230 from 2027-01-01.
- I tagged Ilse in the reply and asked where 261 came from.

The share listing I can open shows only public files, so I read the order form and amendments from the brain's North team pages, not the share. I'm assuming Dana can see them because she's on the North team and owns the account. Seat counts and dates aren't finance figures, so sharing them in #north-team is fine. I left out all pricing and discount terms.
